system.description:
You exude an aura of holiness; your voice is like that of an angel and an inner light seems to radiate from you. Others worship you, and even those who want to harm you find it hard to take action. The true source of this blessing is unknown, but those who observe you believe God has anointed you in some manner.

Blessed does not confer the benefits of True Faith, but observers may well believe the character is touched by God in that way regardless. Blessed conveys the same benefits as Majesty (Presence, Level Five) among the character's flock, as long as she does nothing to break the divine perception they have of her.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
